bug_semantics: MCP create_workflow_from_code persists node.credentials after validateWorkflowCredentialReferences. That validator's computeActiveCredentialTypes copies the runtime CredentialsPermissionChecker.getActiveCredentialTypes filter: it inserts the unresolved string values of node.parameters.nodeCredentialType and genericAuthType into the active-type set, then skips any credential key not in that set. When the authentication type is an n8n expression (for example `={{ "httpHeaderAuth" }}`), the raw expression never equals the real credential key, so the project-scope ownership classifier is skipped and a credential ID from another project is written onto the new workflow. Exploitation needs MCP enabled, a valid MCP Bearer API key, and knowledge of a target credential ID. The execution-time permission gate still refuses to load the foreign credential, so the impact is unauthorized persistence of a cross-project credential reference (CWE-639), not secret exfiltration.
flaw_origin: GitHub PR n8n-io/n8n#32353 (ADO-5424) added project-scoped MCP credential validation to stop create_workflow_from_code from baking in IDs the target project cannot use. The first public member of that squash, d184bf77fee4b9f4f31f05d5e0f487a5e4157c4c, first wrote computeActiveCredentialTypes by mirroring the then-unpatched runtime getActiveCredentialTypes (no isExpression guard) and the skip `if (activeTypes !== null && !activeTypes.has(credentialKey)) continue`. Later members of the same PR only tightened the update-path nodeAcceptsCredentialKey helper and did not change the create-path active-type filter. The runtime path gained isExpression on 2026-07-22 (2222fe3a6c886a9059f28e1b6d4bdb10ee420624); MCP was not updated until the 2026-08-05 security bundle.

reasoning: The first-party advisory GHSA-vfrj-582q-mvcp and published CVE-2026-77073 describe a real persist-time authorization bypass in MCP create_workflow_from_code when a node's auth type is an expression: the credential-reference validator treated the unresolved expression as the active type, so it never matched the real credential key and skipped the cross-project ownership check. CVE.org state is PUBLISHED, so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE. git log -L on computeActiveCredentialTypes and the create-path skip line show those vulnerable lines were first written as part of PR #32353's incomplete ADO-5424 mitigation. The default-branch object 7ddde951cc is a GitHub squash aggregate and is therefore not the BIC; the reconstructable first public member d184bf77fee4b9f4f31f05d5e0f487a5e4157c4c first added computeActiveCredentialTypes (copying the then-unguarded runtime getActiveCredentialTypes) and the skip in validateWorkflowCredentialReferences, and hooked that function from create-workflow-from-code.tool.ts. Immediate parent 8ea8bc3451bef9caa8c2247621c574a17945f660 is present in the clone and lacks both the function and the create-path call, so introducer_parent_absent is false. Later PR members did not rewrite the create-path filter. That BIC precedes the affected 2.33.3/2.34.0 tags (squash first appears in n8n@2.28.0). The public fix that first added isExpression on master is ca3d42d838; the same hunk is in the 2.33.4 and 2.34.1 backports named by the advisory.
